newsitem.title: USA: Summit County in Utah faces division proposal.
newsitem.headline: Summit County in Utah faces division proposal.

text.p: Summit County, Utah, could be carved up under a proposal by a group of local residents, officials said on Monday.
The proposal would create Park County on land that is currently part of Summit County.
Park County proponents have submitted a draft petition calling for a special election on the issue.
They still have to collect the signatures of one-fourth of the local electorate in order to qualify for the ballot, Summit County attorney Robert Adkins said.
If they are successful, Adkins said the Park County proposal could be placed on the local ballot in July.
The proposed county would encompass the Park City school district.
